sources.title: SuperLU users guide
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: MUMPS：填充比、消去排序與前緣記憶體
related.titleEn: MUMPS: fill ratios, elimination ordering and frontal memory
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：精化收益以可重算證據支持，條件界不冒稱等式。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Support refinement gains with reproducible evidence; a conditioning bound is not an equality.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「MUMPS：填充比、消去排序與前緣記憶體」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付排序與消去樹摘要、填充表、前緣生命期與同精度成本比較。
related.differenceEn: Investigate MUMPS: fill ratios, elimination ordering and frontal memory using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver ordering and elimination-tree summaries, fill tables, frontal lifetimes and equal-accuracy cost comparisons that keep symbolic estimates distinct from numerical-factorization observations.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算殘差 [−0.01,1]，取最大絕對值一；分母為 1000×1.01+1000，再比較解誤差。
將二十五萬除五萬，並畫原稀疏圖與新增填充示意；說明填充來源是消去產生的新耦合。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute residual [-0.01,1] and its infinity norm one. Form denominator 1000*1.01+1000, then separately calculate the solution error relative to [1,1], preserving the distinction between the two diagnostics.

Divide two hundred fifty thousand by fifty thousand and sketch original sparsity plus illustrative fill edges. Explain how elimination creates new couplings rather than assuming every factor entry existed in the original matrix.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LLNL Merlin：樣本身分、階段展開與自適應預算
related.titleEn: LLNL Merlin: sample identity, stage expansion and adaptive budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：精化收益以可重算證據支持，條件界不冒稱等式。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Support refinement gains with reproducible evidence; a conditioning bound is not an equality.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「LLNL Merlin：樣本身分、階段展開與自適應預算」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付樣本表、三階段 DAG、代別識別碼與自適應預算證據。
related.differenceEn: Investigate LLNL Merlin: sample identity, stage expansion and adaptive budgets using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver sample manifests, three-stage DAGs, generation identifiers and adaptive-budget evidence linking every analysis output to its exact simulation input.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算殘差 [−0.01,1]，取最大絕對值一；分母為 1000×1.01+1000，再比較解誤差。
為每樣本畫前處理到模擬到分析，列六十個邏輯鍵；另按階段各二十核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute residual [-0.01,1] and its infinity norm one. Form denominator 1000*1.01+1000, then separately calculate the solution error relative to [1,1], preserving the distinction between the two diagnostics.

Draw preprocessing-to-simulation-to-analysis for every sample and enumerate sixty logical keys. Cross-check twenty entries per stage, ensuring stage names cannot collide or overwrite artifacts from another sample.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
